chapter: Childhood, family and the sounds of New Orleans
title: Grandmother says jazz is the Devil's music
summary: His paternal grandmother disapproved of jazz and had never seen a movie.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: My grandma said, "Jazz music is nothin' but the Devil's music, because it entices people to live a fast life. Danny, that's not no life," she told me when I first started... "Son, you're going to be a Jazz...play that music? That ain't no way to make no honest living." My grandmother, Miss Barker, had never seen a movie. She said that was a Devil's contraption. People go there, nice, good people go and see that, and it puts notions in people's heads to do the things they see in that thing.
That's amazing. They lived for quite a long time, until you were grown, didn't they?
I remember when we were talking about that. That's amazing.
